Revision 1 will be a new, self-contained, data-dependent algorithm that computes each candidate's reader-defined score len(cells)*len(unique occurrence paths) from sample.json, selects up to the sample budget maximizing total score subject to pairwise-disjoint physical-cell sets, and writes only sampleSha256 and selected.

The revision-1 generation is measured and both rules PASS. Observation #000031 read the new selection.json (sha256 86911f64dfb1ac48bc74cab4bc0512b0198c0c271223fb2c15c18c2b4b808fb8, 147 bytes) and derived selection_score=21, selected_count=2, conflict_count=0. The chooser selection-repair therefore decides goalMet:true, so no further generation is opened and the Goal stays exactly as fixed at minimum_score=21.
